workable-ink.$description: Workable Ink — Headlines, body copy, icon fills, dark UI surfaces — near-black with a blue-ink undertone, softer than pure black

page-canvas.$description: Page Canvas — Default page background and warm card surface — slightly cream-tinted off-white that gives the whole site a paper-like warmth

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Elevated card surfaces on warm canvas, nav background — true white used sparingly for crisp product panels against the cream page

body-graphite.$description: Body Graphite — Body paragraph text, secondary link color — softened dark gray for readable prose without the weight of ink-black

muted-slate.$description: Muted Slate — Eyebrow labels, helper text, metadata — medium gray for de-emphasized copy like section kickers and timestamps

hairline-gray.$description: Hairline Gray — Disabled button background, subtle dividers — the lightest neutral surface

forest-teal.$description: Forest Teal — Teal text accent for links, tags, and emphasized short phrases. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

midnight-violet.$description: Midnight Violet — Secondary action (Check it out pill), stat callout headings — deep indigo-violet used sparingly for the announcement bar and number highlights

lavender-wash.$description: Lavender Wash — Soft feature card background — pastel lavender for the most prominent colored card surface, gives sections a calm purple identity

peach-cream.$description: Peach Cream — Section background wash, hero-adjacent panels — warm peach-cream used as a large surface band, the dominant chromatic neutral

butter-yellow.$description: Butter Yellow — Card background for warm-themed feature panels — muted butter for secondary colored cards

periwinkle.$description: Periwinkle — Violet wash for highlight backgrounds, decorative bands, and soft emphasis behind content.

sky-tint.$description: Sky Tint — Cool-tone card background — pale sky blue for variety in the pastel card rotation

agent-spectrum.$description: Agent Spectrum — Gradient brand accent for the AI agent visual identity — the mint→lime→violet spectrum used in product illustration and the Workable 'w' logo glow

proxima-nova.$description: Single sans family carries all UI — bold 700 at 56–72px with tight 1.14 line-height creates editorial display weight, while 400 at 18–20px with 1.56–1.67 line-height keeps body comfortable. The Minor Third scale (1.2 ratio, 16px base) produces a restrained 8-step hierarchy.
